class.name: NetwSceneConfig
class.brief_description: Makes a node a multiplayer scene.
class.description:
Returned by [method Netw.configure_multiplayer_scene]. Declare it once from the scene root's [method Object._init], the methods can be called in any order. [codeblock] extends Node2D
func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_multiplayer_scene(self).labeled(&"Level1").isolated() [/codeblock] Every entity below the root belongs to the scene through [member NetwEntity.scene], and [member NetwEntity.is_multiplayer_scene] is [code]true[/code] on the root.

method.name: isolated
method.description: Gives the scene its own physics and render world, so it does not collide with or draw over other scenes. [method Netw.spawn] then returns a [SubViewport] with the scene root inside, and that is what the caller parents. [codeblock] var mount := Netw.spawn(spawn_level1) # a SubViewport worlds.add_child(mount) [/codeblock] On a listen server, [HostSceneView] draws it while it is [member NetwSessionHandle.presented_scene].

method.name: labeled
method.description: Names the scene for [method Netw.scene]. Defaults to the root node's name. [method Netw.scene] fails when several live scenes share the label. Use the node returned by [method Netw.spawn] to select an instance.

members.member: The name given to [method labeled], or the root node's name.
